name: Pyrite
description: Fool's gold: cubes of pyrite grown into each other at right angles.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 6%; top: 14%; width: 56%; height: 56%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 93.3% 25.0%, 93.3% 75.0%, 50.0% 100.0%, 6.7% 75.0%, 6.7% 25.0%); clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 93.3% 25.0%, 93.3% 75.0%, 50.0% 100.0%, 6.7% 75.0%, 6.7% 25.0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 36%; top: 32%; width: 56%; height: 56%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 93.3% 25.0%, 93.3% 75.0%, 50.0% 100.0%, 6.7% 75.0%, 6.7% 25.0%); clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 93.3% 25.0%, 93.3% 75.0%, 50.0% 100.0%, 6.7% 75.0%, 6.7% 25.0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @even { -webkit-transform: scaleX(-1); transform: scaleX(-1); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
